_comment: Expectations for `junit-metrics.ts` over the four-leg baseline.
`requiredTests` are the nine timeout-shaped tests the predecessor fix's
acceptance criterion 4 measures: their absence from a leg is a gate failure,
so a run that silently stopped executing one cannot read as a speed-up.
`enforceTimeoutFloors` stays false for the baseline because those floors were
ratified under the pre-fix first-event grace; Phase 3 re-derives them under
the 2026-08-31 spawn-fallback silence clock and Phase 9 turns enforcement on
